networks.name: chip_autopsy_lab
networks.description: Wafer-lot failure autopsy: read yield, rank failing bins, check parametric capability, classify the WM-811K spatial signature, and get a verdict-first cause of death where every claim cites an engine fact id.
sample_queries: Why did this lot lose yield? Give me the cause of death and the evidence.
Which failing bin took the most dies, and what share of the failures is that?
Load the edge-ring demo lot and diagnose it.
What spatial signature does this lot show, and which dies carry it?
Which parametric test has the worst Cpk, and what are its limits?
Compare yield across test sites. Is one probe site worse?
List the engine facts behind the verdict and their die counts.

llm_router.note: The site funds no inference. Visitors bring their own OpenAI-compatible router, model and key; with no key the console runs the same network on a deterministic demo router that assembles answers from real tool results.

peer_policy.note: The published network may call Agent Atlas (a public conformance checker for agentic websites) after the visitor approves the contact. Any other origin needs the visitor's explicit approval and is recorded in the execution trace.

actions.note: Handlers are registered by the page that hosts the runtime and run on this origin only. list_demo_lots, get_lot_summary, diagnose_lot, get_spatial_pattern, get_parametric_report, compare_test_sites, query_dies, list_evidence, get_evidence and export_report read aggregate engine facts; load_demo_lot and highlight_dies change the page and wait for the visitor's confirmation. Cross-origin invocation of these actions is outside MVP Profile 0.3.
